subproblems.title: Establish an identifiable same-task, same-model, same-budget benchmark

key_points: DGM reports improvement from 20.0% to 50.0% on SWE-bench through self-modification plus archive-based open-ended exploration.
Its released search uses staged evaluation and a growing archive, so final score and search cost must be reported separately.
The published checkout loads big.json and computes full_eval_threshold but never executes the 140-task third stage.
The released result contains 197-200-task nodes, implying code/data drift from the public runner.
findings.conflict: The paper describes 10->60->200 promotion, but the released main branch cannot reproduce its third stage.

key_points: Logged data observes rewards only for actions selected by the logging policy.
Deficient action support and distribution shift limit off-policy conclusions.

subproblems.title: Find a method that reduces evaluated-node count while preserving task performance

key_points: Successive halving allocates increasing fidelity only to competitive candidates.
BOHB combines strong anytime multi-fidelity allocation with model-guided proposal.
Prior-guided successive halving can reduce sample cost when priors are informative.
A robust design must recover prior-free behavior when the prior is uninformative or misleading.
AgentGA uses deterministic elite tournaments and online Hedge allocation over mutation operators.
Fresh workspaces plus curated inherited artifacts separate generation from reusable lineage information.
Graph-constrained counterfactual replay represents interacting and alternative repair sets that pointwise rankings miss.
Its reported 52-55% replay saving is domain-bounded controlled evidence, not a guarantee for harness evolution.
Stopping should compare expected improvement with heterogeneous evaluation cost rather than use a fixed probe count.
Cost-adjusted simple regret is the appropriate joint quality-cost objective.

subproblems.title: Implement staged Pi, DGM-style, and CLM experiments

key_points: Conservative direct-regression quarantine saved 0% on full DGM because flagged nodes were leaves.
Aggressive net-loss quarantine saved 86.28% but reduced the full-DGM endpoint from 0.5000 to 0.2833.
The primary H9 rule passed only one of three released runs and was killed.
Stability-gated promotion preserved the 0.5000 node and saved 21.21% on the official split.
Across 5000 hash task rotations it hit the best node only 89.46% and saved 6.58%, so H10 was killed.
Repair-first CLM passed all seven synthetic settings, including conjunctive, alternative, mixed, noisy, low-recall, misleading-prior, and DGM-depth cases.
It preserved repair within the 0.02 non-inferiority margin and reduced calls by 42.86%-49.89% versus failure-first repair; every paired bootstrap interval excluded zero.
SWE-bench recommends at least 8 CPUs, 16GB RAM, and 120GB disk for Docker evaluation.
The local Docker VM was restored with 8 CPUs, 16 GiB RAM, and a 120 GiB Docker data disk before endpoint evaluation.
On DGM's 10-task small development subset, isolated Pi resolves 5/10 and Pi plus three verified RF-CLM repairs resolves 8/10.
The three one-call repairs add 137391 reported tokens, or 3.99% of the 10-task Pi baseline total.
findings.conflict: The endpoint gateway reported 20473-51860 output tokens per repair despite an 8192 max_tokens request, so monetary cost is not yet reliable.

key_points: The best released DGM node resolves 4/10 on the same small task IDs.
The released DGM node uses a different model and agent substrate, so it is a historical reference rather than a matched causal baseline.
The official SWE-bench grader resolves all three RF candidates: django__django-13346, django__django-15930, and django__django-10999.
Each report records all FAIL_TO_PASS tests passing and no PASS_TO_PASS regressions.

uncertain_points: Released DGM trajectories do not identify counterfactual children under a different parent policy.
No matching original-Pi predictions exist in the released DGM artifacts.
The public DGM runner and released 200-task results were produced from different code paths or revisions.
The DGM-small result is a development-set comparison, not a matched multi-seed evolution result on the untouched 140-task holdout.
The endpoint gateway exceeded the requested max_tokens value, so billable-token and monetary-cost comparisons remain unreliable.
